review_scope_note: Fresh context; full manuscript, all appendix source and bibliography, and all 32 PDF pages visually inspected. No research code/data/registries/sealed material accessed.
prompt:
You are reviewing a TMLR paper as a senior ML reviewer. This is a fresh, zero-context review. Inspect the entire manuscript source and the entire compiled PDF, including every appendix page and all figures/tables. Read `/Users/nigelli/Desktop/ICML/shift-paper3-f3/paper/f3_tmlr/main.tex`, all files it inputs under `paper/f3_tmlr/`, and visually inspect `/Users/nigelli/Desktop/ICML/shift-paper3-f3/paper/f3_tmlr/main.pdf` (all 32 pages). Do not open any research data, code, seed registries, or sealed groups; paper text mentioning seeds is permitted. Judge only from current manuscript source and PDF.

Review writing quality, rigor, claim calibration in both directions, narrative, self-containedness, notation, citations, and visual presentation. Avoid adding hedges to supported claims. Flag stacked hedges, defensive/process narration, and repetition. Never delete unfavorable results or dress a weakness as a tradeoff. Keep facts, direction, scope, modality, and numbers intact in suggested edits. No new experiments or numerical changes; requests for new evidence should be marked open items.

Provide: (1) overall score 1–10 (6 weak accept, 7 accept); (2) 2–3 sentence summary; (3) ranked strengths; (4) ranked weaknesses with Critical/Major/Minor levels; (5) actionable fixes for Critical/Major; (6) missing references if any; (7) full visual review of figure quality/readability, caption alignment, layout/float placement, tables, consistency; (8) verdict Yes/Almost/No. Give specific source locations and preserve negative results. Read the full source and PDF; do not infer scope from partial materials.
